# discord_end_poll (Action)

Ends a poll immediately. Only polls the bot posted can be ended.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.discord_end_poll.lunch
action "discord_end_poll" "lunch" {
  config {
    channel_id = discord_text_channel.general.id
    message_id = "345678901234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the message is in.
- `message_id` (String) ID of the message.
